zh: 每个女孩只能靠左右两个紧邻的空位来覆盖。从左往右看，第一个还没被覆盖的女孩，她左边的女孩都已经处理好了。
对这个女孩，如果右边是空位就放在右边：右边的男孩还可能顺带覆盖后面的女孩，至少不比放左边差。右边不行才放左边，两边都不行就无解。
从左到右扫描下标 i：不是女孩或左边已放男孩就跳过；右边是 '-' 就在 i+1 放男孩并跳到 i+2；否则左边是 '-' 就在 i−1 放男孩；都不行输出 −1。最后输出放置的男孩数。
en: A girl can only be covered by one of her two directly adjacent empty seats. Scanning from the left, every girl before the first uncovered one is already handled.

For that girl, place the boy on the right if that seat is empty: a boy there may also cover a later girl, so it is never worse than the left seat. Use the left seat only if the right one is unavailable, and if neither works there is no solution.

Scan index i from left to right: skip it if it is not a girl or a boy already sits on its left; if the right seat is '-', place a boy at i+1 and jump to i+2; otherwise if the left seat is '-', place a boy at i−1; otherwise output −1. Finally output the number of boys placed.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Process the not-yet-covered girls from left to right. Prefer the empty seat to her right, which can also cover the next adjacent girl; if it is not available, try the left one. Exhaustively enumerating all placement subsets serves as an independent oracle.

## Proof of correctness

Consider the leftmost girl not yet covered by a boy. Any feasible solution must place a boy in an empty seat to her left or right. If the right seat is available, moving the left-seat boy of some optimal solution to the right seat does not increase the count and also covers later girls. If the right seat is unavailable, only the left seat can be chosen. After repeated exchanges the greedy choices agree with some optimal solution.

## Complexity

Each boy is placed only in an originally empty seat; the count does not exceed |s|.

O(n) time, O(n) space.

## Reference implementation

```python
def solve(raw):
 s=raw.strip();placed=set();i=0
 while i<len(s):
  if s[i]!='G' or i-1 in placed:i+=1;continue
  if i+1<len(s) and s[i+1]=='-':placed.add(i+1);i+=2
  elif i>0 and s[i-1]=='-':placed.add(i-1);i+=1
  else:return '-1'
 return str(len(placed))
```
